name: Twilight Marauders
label: Quest
description: Twilight Marauders: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Bands of mounted Twilight's Hammer cultists have been spotted riding outside the reach of our forces in Cenarion Hold, picking off our smaller patrols and caravans.
Find and defeat the twilight marauders along with their leader, a terrible warrior by the name of Morna. Report to Windcaller Proudhorn after completing the task.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Is your task done yet, friend?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Well done, friend. The twilight marauders were inflicting an unacceptable number of casualties on our patrols. Here's your next assignment.
